title: Controlling Experts with Understandable Commands" by Shumeet Baluja,
summary: Builds on our Ledge open-source release (Interpretable Actions, AAAI-21): expert models are controlled through human-readable commands, demonstrated by reconstructing a 1-D function, correcting residual error, extracting interpretable commands, and fine-tuning them. We are evaluating the command-extraction pipeline as an interpretability layer for data-platform models.
